ideas.pitch: A real-time proxy gateway for enterprise LLM applications that intercepts user prompts, detects adversarial jailbreaks and indirect prompt injections using vector similarity and classifiers, and sanitizes outputs before they reach downstream models.
ideas.title: AegisLog: LLM Prompt Injection & Jailbreak Defense Gateway
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns perfectly with the LLMs & Automation domain by addressing the most critical production vulnerability facing enterprise AI deployments, capturing judge attention via rigorous security engineering.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered monitoring tool that ingests open-source satellite imagery and uses fine-tuned vision models to automatically detect unauthorized industrial land usage, deforestation, and zoning violations for regulatory agencies.
ideas.title: AgriVision: Satellite Land Compliance & Deforestation Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mimics a proven hackathon winner by combining geospatial data intelligence with computer vision, solving a tangible regulatory pain point that appeals to judges looking for real-world impact.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous multi-agent system that ingests unstructured company policy documents, financial ledgers, and operational logs, then uses collaborative LLM agents to cross-reference regulations and generate comprehensive audit risk reports.
ideas.title: AutoAudit: Multi-Agent Regulatory Compliance Pipeline
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the powerful LLMs & Automation domain theme with an architecture that demonstrates complex multi-agent orchestration rather than a simple single-prompt wrapper.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent patient onboarding and triage assistant for specialized clinics that parses unstructured medical histories, validates insurance pre-authorizations, and generates transparent treatment explanations for patients.
ideas.title: MediTrust: AI-Powered Patient Intake & Trust Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact blueprint of a verified 1st-prize winner by solving specialized healthcare workflow bottlenecks where trust, accuracy, and clear communication are paramount.

ideas.pitch: An advanced multimodal search and summarization platform that ingests hours of recorded enterprise meetings or lectures, transcribes audio, extracts key visual frames, and constructs an interactive, queryable knowledge graph.
ideas.title: DocuMorph: Unstructured Video & Audio Knowledge Base
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates a proven first-place winning formula by turning unwieldy unstructured multimedia into instantly searchable and structured intelligence, dazzling judges during live demos.
